assets.name: factory-cabinet
assets.clearance: Open tray for two-by-two interactive tiles; keep top-down visibility and tap access.

acceptanceCases: all four tiles through full quarter-turn, including 45 degrees; rim cannot cover or intersect tile sweep
preserve cellOf/tap mapping; fixed two-by-two GLB not a general variable grid

door separate or code; current constructor displays it open, no swing animation to claim

assets.name: safety-press
assets.clearance: Empty central press span throughout ram travel; do not fuse columns to ram.
assets.runtimeNote: Columns X ±0.75, Z -0.35; code ram centre Y=PLATE_TOP+1.4, Z=-0.35; code anvil 1.2×0.3×0.8.
acceptanceCases: ramY0,0.5,1; head clears frame and rod passes top beam through an actual opening
do not close the existing 0.175 anvil gap by changing animation without integrator decision
buttons and both terminals remain accessible
include neither ram nor code controls in static body

assets.name: lathe
assets.clearance: Empty axial span between headstock and tailstock; no baked rotating cylinder.
assets.runtimeNote: m0410: selected v2 has no static dial and leaves flat top mounting area. Code dial centre(-0.7,PLATE_TOP+1.25,+0.5), r0.3, south-facing.
acceptanceCases: spindle full rotation and fast-speed ±.03Y vibration without static intersections
align hollow inward bearing openings to code axis rather than scaling body solely by outer width
dial, green band and needle remain code-driven and visible from south
back-left input shaft/gear remain reachable; do not bake their moving function into reference

assets.name: hoist
assets.clearance: Open front and shaft over full cabin travel; sparse mesh must preserve real openings.
assets.runtimeNote: Generate/extract static tower only. Cabin visible in PNG is a reference for clearance, not part of the delivered GLB. Integration must be factory-only.

factory-only skin selected by integrator; farm Lift and driver=false kitten behavior remain unchanged
GLB static shaft contains no baked cabin, rope or pulley; existing code supplies these
cabinFloor() world location unchanged so rider follows platform
pulley and rope must remain animated separately; static reference top motor is decor only
inspect existing roof/top shell overlap in real mesh rather than inheriting it as desired tolerance
assets.integrationDecision: Claude m0417: factory-only skin; preserve original farm Lift; cabin/rope/pulley remain code.

coordinateBasis.space: Part.root local; absolute Y includes PLATE_TOP=0.16 unless named relative
coordinateBasis.fit: model() rotates Y, uses one requested dimension for uniform scaling, centres bbox X/Z, places minY=0; then integrator adds body placement. Measure moving clearance after this transform.
